hooks.text: Live roundworms survived a shuttle's fiery breakup.
A foam strike doomed Space Shuttle Columbia.
Eighty-four thousand pieces of wreckage fell over Texas.

title: The Shuttle Worms That Survived Death
description: Live roundworms survived Space Shuttle Columbia's disintegration during re-entry.
